answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments bind each agent to an immutable history while a sequential verifiable delay function forces any cloning attempt to exceed the epoch budget. Staking collateral of 1e6 tokens with deterministic slashing of 90% and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay yields negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium. The protocol achieves cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance as its echo of state roots across shale layers prevents sybil amplification across dune topologies.
